title: 16-06-pace-code-c-2015.pdf — section 5
text:
1.11 This Code does not apply to people in custody:
(a) arrested by officers under the Criminal Justice and Public
Order Act 1994, section 136(3), on warrants issued in
Scotland or arrested or detained without warrant by
officers from Police Scotland under section 137(2). In
these cases, police powers and duties and the person’s
rights and entitlements whilst at a police station in
Northern Ireland are the same as those in Scotland;
(b) arrested under the Immigration and Asylum Act 1999,
section 142(3) in order to have their fingerprints taken;
(c) whose detention has been authorised under Schedules 2 or

3 to the Immigration Act 1971 or section 62 of the
Nationality, Immigration and Asylum Act 2002;
(d) Not used.
(e) detained for searches under stop and search powers except
as required by Code A.
The provisions on conditions of detention and treatment in
sections 8 and 9 must be considered as the minimum standards of
treatment for such detainees.
